text:
The spectator's thought is an overgeneralization (hasty generalization): they apply a trait to an entire group ("all" welfare recipients) from limited or anecdotal impressions, which also makes it a stereotype. The note about unequal treatment doesn't change this. A spoken statement is a biased belief or attitude, so it is prejudice at most, and it only becomes discrimination if it is acted on through unequal treatment.

CONFIDENCE: 80
